title: EA SPORTS FC™ 27 sets the soundtrack of the new Football season
summary: Featuring 120 tracks from 36 nations, the EA SPORTS FC™ 27 Soundtrack builds on more than 20 years of music discovery.
body_markdown:
Today, we unveil[the official Soundtrack for EA SPORTS FC™ 27](https://www.ea.com/games/ea-sports-fc/fc-27/news/fc-27-soundtrack) , bringing together 120 tracks from 36 nations to mark the start of the new 2026/27 football season.


For more than two decades, the EA SPORTS FC Soundtrack has become part of the ritual of a new season and been one of football and music’s most recognizable cultural touchpoints, connecting millions of fans with new artists from around the globe.


As anticipation builds ahead of Early Access on September 18 and the game’s worldwide launch on September 25, the EA SPORTS FC™ 27 Soundtrack continues its legacy with a diverse mix of internationally renowned artists, breakthrough talent, and unreleased music, reflecting the global communities that make up The World's Game.


The FC 27 Soundtrack,[exclusively on Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/playlist/37i9dQZF1DX4vgOVqe6BJn?si=2fce8a0817d9407b) , spans established artist favorites, including **Interpol** , **The Neighbourhood** , **The Strokes** , **The War on Drugs** , **Royal Blood** , **Nia Archives** , **Chase & Status** , **Little Simz** and **Barry Can't Swim** , alongside exciting emerging talent such as **The Itch** , **Sycco** , **Bruvvy** , **Temper City** , **bed** and **Rose Gray** . Fans can also discover unreleased gems from **Cage The Elephant** , **Mura Masa** and many others, alongside **Sayf’s “TOP OF THE POPS (Red Bull 64 Bars)”** track, in a collection that captures the anticipation, energy and excitement for the football season ahead.


"I’ve been playing EA SPORTS' football games since 2007; It’s something that’s been with me since I was a kid," said **KYAN, EA SPORTS FC 27 Soundtrack Artist** . “I always had this dream of one day turning on the game and hearing my own song playing there. It’s crazy that it's happened now, with the track ‘Garage’ with Enzo from the Block and Mu540, because our friendship also started through the game. We didn’t even speak the same language, but we could spend hours playing and understanding each other. I feel like 10-year-old Kyan would go crazy if he knew that one day this was going to happen."


“EA always puts together a killer soundtrack for FC, so we were thrilled to have our brand-new song ‘Dying In Reverse’ make its debut this year,” said **Cage the Elephant, EA SPORTS FC 27 Soundtrack Artist** . “We can’t wait to hear it in the game.”


This year, music plays a bigger role than ever before across the EA SPORTS FC experience.


Through[The Grounds](https://www.ea.com/games/ea-sports-fc/fc-27/news/pitch-notes-fc27-the-grounds-deep-dive) *, a new shared social football playground in FC 27, players will experience distinct musical identities across three districts inspired by English, French and Argentinian football heritage: Parkside, Montclair, and Zeiza. Each location is brought to life through its own curated Soundtrack, immersing players in the sounds and atmosphere that represent the identity of each football hub.


Additionally,[FC Mobile is celebrating its third anniversary](https://www.ea.com/games/ea-sports-fc/fc-mobile/anniversary) by allowing players to vote for music to be added in-game. Following a vote on fan-favorite tracks from across EA SPORTS FC Soundtrack history, players will also have the chance to make their voice heard and[vote on which of five songs](https://www.ea.com/games/ea-sports-fc/fc-mobile/anniversary/soundtrack) from the new FC 27 Soundtrack should be added to the game from September 10-12. The winning retro track will arrive in FC Mobile on September 24, followed by the community’s favorite FC 27 track on October 12.


“ *Over the past 20 years, the EA SPORTS FC Soundtrack has become an international institution,* ” said **Steve Schnur, Worldwide President of Music & Marketing for EA Games** . “ *The world’s game is annually enhanced by the world’s soundtrack, and FC 27 delivers one of our most globally representative playlists yet. These are the songs that will both define the year ahead and last a lifetime. We’re proud to deliver this exceptional celebration of artistry, culture and the power of music to bring people together like never before.*


Listen to the EA SPORTS FC 27 Soundtrack on[Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/playlist/37i9dQZF1DX4vgOVqe6BJn?si=2fce8a0817d9407b) today. Players can go back in time and relive some of the most iconic songs from FC soundtracks through the[EA SPORTS FC Ultimate Mix playlist](https://open.spotify.com/playlist/37i9dQZF1DWTMWIpgAlsRJ?si=90a085535a104e69) , also on Spotify.


[Pre-orders are now available](https://www.ea.com/games/ea-sports-fc/fc-27/buy) for EA SPORTS FC™ 27, which will launch on PlayStation®5, PlayStation®4, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, PC, Nintendo Switch, and Nintendo Switch 2. EA SPORTS FC™ 27 will be available worldwide to play on September 25, 2026 with Ultimate Edition and Ultimate Plus Edition early access beginning September 18, 2026**.


For more information on EA SPORTS FC™ 27, please visit[ea.com/fc27](https://www.ea.com/games/ea-sports-fc/fc-27) and ensure you’re following our global[social channels](https://linktr.ee/easportsfc) for all the latest upcoming news and announcements for EA SPORTS FC™.


*The Grounds mode (including Clubs) is available only on PlayStation®5, Xbox Series X|S, PC and Nintendo Switch 2 versions.
